title: Activation Charges and Implementation Windows Across the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Each tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes publishes a one-off implementation charge raised when the programme is activated, and the number of working days its implementation takes from activation.

| Programme tier | One-off implementation charge on activation | Working days the implementation takes from activation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 0.00 USD | 1 working days |
| Business Team Programme | 250.00 USD | 5 working days |
| Business Pro Programme | 950.00 USD | 10 working days |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 3500.00 USD | 20 working days |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 9500.00 USD | 30 working days |
| Business Global Programme | 25000.00 USD | 45 working days |

## Notes

1. The Business Starter Programme is implemented at no charge, its published figure standing at 0.00 USD, and its implementation takes 1 working day.
2. The implementation charge rises with the tier, from 250.00 USD on the Business Team Programme through 950.00 USD, 3500.00 USD and 9500.00 USD to 25000.00 USD on the Business Global Programme; the implementation window lengthens over the same tiers from 5 working days to 45.
3. The charge and the window are published per tier and are not varied by the number of seats the company contracts for.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A company activating a Business Pro Programme is raised the 950.00 USD implementation charge published for that tier, and the implementation of that programme is scheduled over 10 working days.
